import {SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION,validateShoukangEntryScope} from '../../../controls/ShoukangEntrySupport.js';
import * as T from 'three';import {createXiqingSurface} from '../../../controls/XiqingRoofSurface.js';import {buildWallCap} from '../../RoofBuilder.js';import {shoukangEntryPaint} from './ShoukangEntryPaint.js';
const SOURCE='https://www.dpm.org.cn/explore/building/236448.html',PHOTO='https://img.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/Picture/2020/04/16/s5e98213db7ce7.jpg';
export function validateShoukangEntryCourtWall(i){if(i?.kind!=='courtWalls'||i.x0!==268.63||i.x1!==309.77||i.z0!==193.9||i.z1!==273.02||(i.h!==undefined&&i.h!==6.5)||(i.t!==undefined&&i.t!==1)||i.gates?.length!==1||i.gates[0].side!=='s'||i.gates[0].at!==288.6||i.gates[0].gate!=='寿康门')throw Error('Shoukang entry requires its exact sole south court boundary');return true;}
export function shoukangEntryGeometry(item,zoneId='outer-west'){if(zoneId!=='outer-west'||item?.kind!=='gate'||item.name!=='寿康门'||item.x!==288.6||item.z!==193.9||item.gateProfile!=='shoukang-entry'||item.gateKind!=='single-glazed-wall-portal'||item.rot!=='south'||item.open!==true||['w','h','t','layers','eaveCount','roof','brackets'].some(k=>item[k]!==undefined))throw Error('Shoukang entry exact named gate binding required');return{profile:'shoukang-entry',x:288.6,z:193.9,width:6.4,depth:2.8,clearWidth:3.6,portalCount:1,portalCenters:[0],floor:Math.fround(.1),frontWall:{x0:268.63,x1:309.77,z:193.9,height:4.4,sourceBoundedWholeSouth:true,unboundSideDoorsAndBuildings:'UNMODELED'},acceptedWholeObject:false,source:SOURCE,photo:PHOTO,precision:'PHOTO_RELATIONSHIP_MODEL_FIT_NOT_SURVEYED',doorPose:'MODEL_OPEN_NOT_CURRENT_ACCESS',unverified:['gate back','fine glazed relief and Manchu inscription','door-god pictures','stone carving','surrounding court buildings and unbound side doors','GPU visual and performance']};}
export function buildShoukangEntry(kit,item,zoneId){const g=shoukangEntryGeometry(item,zoneId),f=kit.frame(g.x,g.z,0);f.name='寿康门整体入口';f.userData.structure=g;f.userData.shoukangEntry=g;f.userData.gateGeometry=g;const paint=shoukangEntryPaint(kit),boxes=[],surfaces=[];const tag=(m,role)=>{m.name='shoukang-entry-'+role;Object.assign(m.userData,{role:m.name,shoukangEntry:true,source:SOURCE,photo:PHOTO,precision:g.precision});return m;};
 const bottomGeometry=(geometry,h)=>{const p=geometry.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)p.setY(i,Math.max(0,Math.min(h,p.getY(i)+h/2)));return geometry;};
 const box=(role,w,h,d,x,y,z,material='wall_red',pattern=null)=>{const m=tag(kit.mesh(f,bottomGeometry(new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),h),typeof material==='string'?kit.lib.material(material):material,x,y,z),role);boxes.push(m);if(pattern)paint.draw(m,pattern);return m;};
 const floor=box('threshold',6.6,.1,3.3,0,0,0,'stone_slab');floor.userData.shoukangWalkable=true;
 for(const side of[-1,1]){const x=side*2.5;box('pier-stone-base',1.5,1,2.9,x+side*.05,0,0,'stone_slab');box('pier-body',1.4,4.9,2.8,x,1,0,paint.body.red,'pier');}
 box('header',3.6,1.5,2.8,0,4.4,0,paint.body.green,'beam');
 for(const side of[-1,1]){const m=box('open-leaf',1.75,4.3,.09,side*1.86,.1,2.275,paint.body.dark,'leaf');m.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;}
 const central=tag(kit.roof(f,{type:'xieshan',width:6.7,depth:3.3,baseY:5.9,brackets:false,height:1.3}),'central-roof');surfaces.push({root:central,id:'central-roof'});
 for(const side of[-1,1]){const x=side*5.2;box('shoulder-body',4,4.4,1,x,0,0,paint.body.red,'shoulder');const r=tag(kit.roof(f,{type:'xieshan',width:4.3,depth:1.6,baseY:4.4,height:.9,brackets:false,detail:'low'},x,0),side<0?'east-shoulder-roof':'west-shoulder-roof');surfaces.push({root:r,id:side<0?'east-shoulder-roof':'west-shoulder-roof'});}
 for(const [index,[lo,hi]]of [[268.63-g.x,-7.2],[7.2,309.77-g.x]].entries()){const len=hi-lo,x=(lo+hi)/2;box('outer-wall-base',len,1,1.12,x,0,0,'wall_brick');box('outer-wall-body',len,3.4,1,x,1,0,'wall_red');const cap=tag(kit.adopt(buildWallCap(kit.lib,{length:len,thickness:1})),'outer-wall-cap-'+index);cap.position.set(x,4.4,0);f.add(cap);surfaces.push({root:cap,id:'wall-cap-'+index});}
 // Independent white stone stands are not the two pier footings. Coarse closed
 // silhouettes only; no invented carved animals, incense, flowers or relief.
 for(const [index,side]of[-1,1].entries()){const root=tag(new T.Group(),'front-stone-stand');root.position.set(side*4.4,0,-2.5);f.add(root);const stone=kit.lib.material('stone_slab');kit.mesh(root,bottomGeometry(new T.CylinderGeometry(.34,.38,.18,12),.18),stone,0,0,0);kit.mesh(root,bottomGeometry(new T.CylinderGeometry(.17,.23,.99,12),.99),stone,0,.18,0);kit.mesh(root,bottomGeometry(new T.BoxGeometry(.9,.18,.65),.18),stone,0,1.17,0);surfaces.push({root,id:'stone-stand-'+index});}
 kit.plaque(f,'寿康门',0,5.15,-1.53,.72,1.2);const p=kit.plaques.at(-1);tag(p.frame,'nameboard-frame');boxes.push(p.frame);tag(p.mesh,'nameboard-text');surfaces.push({root:p.mesh,id:'nameboard'});
 kit.root.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);const inverse=kit.root.matrixWorld.clone().invert(),point=(m,p,i)=>{const v=new T.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(new T.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(inverse,m.matrixWorld));v.set(Math.fround(v.x),Math.fround(v.y),Math.fround(v.z));return v.applyMatrix4(kit.root.matrixWorld);};
 for(const [index,m]of boxes.entries()){const p=m.geometry.attributes.position,b=new T.Box3();for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++)b.expandByPoint(point(m,p,i));b.shoukangEntry={kind:'visible-box',index,role:m.userData.role};m.userData.shoukangBox=index;m.traverse(n=>{if(n.isMesh)n.userData.shoukangOwner=index});kit.colliders.push(b);if(m.userData.shoukangWalkable){const box=b.clone();box.min.y=box.max.y;kit.walkables.push({type:'box',box,rescue:false});}}
 for(const {root,id}of surfaces){const faces=[];let mesh=0;root.traverse(m=>{if(!m.isMesh)return;const p=m.geometry.attributes.position,ix=m.geometry.index;for(let i=0;i<(ix?.count??p.count);i+=3)faces.push({source:{mesh,triangle:i/3},vertices:[0,1,2].map(k=>point(m,p,ix?ix.getX(i+k):i+k))});m.userData.shoukangSurface={id,mesh};mesh++;});const surface=createXiqingSurface(faces,'shoukang-entry-'+id),box=surface.box.clone();box.xiqingRoofSurface=surface;box.shoukangEntry={kind:'visible-surface',id};kit.colliders.push(box);}
 const anchor=kit.colliders.find(b=>b.shoukangEntry?.role==='shoukang-entry-threshold'),scope={kind:'shoukang-entry',id:'shoukang-entry',minOffsetX:SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION.minX-anchor.min.x,maxOffsetX:SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION.maxX-anchor.min.x,minOffsetZ:SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION.minZ-anchor.min.z,maxOffsetZ:SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION.maxZ-anchor.min.z};validateShoukangEntryScope(scope,anchor,SHOUKANG_ENTRY_REGION);anchor.furnitureMotionScope=scope;
 kit.mapRect(f,'gate','寿康门',g.width,g.depth,{gateProfile:g.profile,portalCount:1,source:SOURCE,precision:g.precision});return{width:g.width,geometry:g,frame:f};}
